pre_end_cards.descHtml: Architect retrieval, inference, and agent workflows: embedding-based retrieval, ranking and reranking, grounded generation, and structured outputs with explicit handling of insufficient evidence.
Ship Python/FastAPI services, reusable retrieval and inference APIs, and React features that connect product workflows to LLMs without duplicating service logic.
Own Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD, observability, and incident response. Tune GPU utilization, latency, and reliability for AI workloads in production.

story-gamification-hero.descHtml:
15+ years in software engineering and 6+ years building production ML and applied AI systems, with staff-level ownership across architecture, hands-on development, evaluation, deployment, and production operations.
Hands-on with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, retrieval and ranking, agent workflows, Python/FastAPI, model serving, Kubernetes, and MLOps — improving GPU utilization ~35% and cutting retrieval latency 15%.

story-gamification-battle-pass.descHtml: Built medical-record retrieval that grounds LLM applications at Novawave, moved customer-facing enterprise LLM applications from proof of concept into production at Larynx, and standardized ML delivery with MLflow at NextEra Energy.

story-gamification-ranks.descHtml: PyTorch, vLLM, model serving, and inference optimization. Feature engineering, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, and recommendation and ranking systems for energy, logistics, and enterprise data.

story-gamification-chests.descHtml:
Technical ownership from design through production operations.

Architecture & code reviews across application, retrieval, and model-provider layers
CI/CD & Kubernetes deployment automation for AI services
Observability with retries, timeouts, health checks, and SLO monitoring
Incident response and performance optimization for GPU workloads

story-gamification-leaderboard.descHtml: Python, LLM and RAG engineering, FastAPI, PyTorch, and Kubernetes — 15+ years across healthcare AI, enterprise LLM applications, energy, logistics, fintech, and cloud platforms.

story-rewards-hero.descHtml: Senior Applied AI/ML Engineer leading architecture, core infrastructure, and delivery of AI services for Ferrum Health medical-record retrieval.
bullets: Lead architecture and delivery of AI services for medical-record retrieval, from evidence selection and LLM inference to product integration and production operations
Designed embedding-based retrieval with candidate selection, ranking, reranking, and context filtering — reducing retrieval latency 15%
Built shared retrieval and inference APIs and model-provider integrations that cut duplicate model API calls 20%
Improved GPU utilization ~35% through model-serving and workload optimization; own CI/CD, Kubernetes deployment automation, and production troubleshooting

story-rewards-referral.descHtml: Senior AI/ML Engineer — moved customer-facing enterprise LLM applications from proof of concept into scalable production.
bullets: Built customer-facing LLM features over enterprise data using embeddings, RAG, and prompt engineering for grounded generation
Designed evidence-constrained answer generation with context filtering and explicit insufficient-information handling — cutting the unsupported-answer rate 15%
Developed Python/FastAPI services and reusable retrieval and inference APIs, keeping AI service logic separate from product application code
Hardened prototypes with automated tests, containerized Kubernetes releases, scaling, and monitoring — reducing release-preparation time 20%

story-rewards-cashback.descHtml: Lead Machine Learning Engineer — led an engineering team delivering production ML services for the NextEra 360 energy management platform.
bullets: Led development of ML services for energy asset analysis and optimization, turning operational telemetry requirements into deployable APIs
Designed Python pipelines connecting generation, consumption, and operational data with model inference — cutting pipeline runtime 20%
Implemented MLflow experiment tracking and model registries, reducing model-handoff time 25% with reproducible deployments
Owned deployment, model monitoring, and support while setting technical direction on architecture, reliability, testing, and CI/CD

story-rewards-staking.descHtml: Senior ML Engineer and Senior Software Engineer on the FootPrint WMS — predictive services and full-stack pack verification for warehouse operations.
metaChips: Senior ML Engineer · Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Applied ML to warehouse and inventory telemetry; built Python pipelines connecting predictive workflows with WMS data, REST APIs, and databases — cutting processing time 15%
Automated recurring inventory and logistics processing, saving 4 hours of manual work per week
Delivered barcode-assisted pack verification across web UI, REST API, business logic, and database — reducing verification time 10%
Profiled and optimized SQL and legacy verification paths, reducing query execution time 20% with regression coverage
